audit: Fresh visual and interaction audit v2, 2026-11-01
provenance: Broad route captures precede late scoped corrections. Each report identifies its actual source/build. Changed price/modal/media/footer regions were retested separately; the complete 46-page matrix was not silently relabelled as a rerun of the final patch. Final functional Chromium, final WebKit states/continuity and both-engine footer checks use the frozen source. Publication is owner-controlled.

environment.execution: Cloud Linux local generated production output, engines run sequentially

responsiveCases.laterVisualFinding: Footer text clipped at 1024 despite no document overflow; resolved by the separately measured footer correction.

nativeInputLimit: WebKit mouse.wheel is unavailable in Playwright mobile mode, so compact native-wheel checks use isMobile=false at 320x740/844x390. Native CDP touch gestures are Chromium-only. Final WebKit states use actual mobile emulation at 390.

checks: Original home, fonts and assets load at 1440/768/390/320; one h1; no horizontal overflow
Mobile menu and menu-to-enquiry Escape paths restore focus to the visible menu button
Catalogue filters remain available after resizing from mobile back to desktop
Catalogue search/empty/reset/filter/sort/reload work; property return restores the original query and selected filters
Property gallery decodes before showing the matching photo/counter, keeps the latest rapid navigation request, and restores focus
Network failure and same-context reopen preserve fields/UUID/start time; pending fields/context are protected; duplicate submit and mismatched receipt cannot report success
Changed payload obtains a new UUID; field errors remain visible; unchanged retry confirms matching receipt; success reopen starts a clean enquiry
All page templates, four development routes and current project links work; Six Senses shows Dubai Marina; insights filter, contact validation and 404 work
Catalogue, property, development, insights and contact templates fit a 390px viewport
Normal-motion card rail reaches both real snap boundaries and disables the correct control
Rapid service changes settle to one open, fully expanded panel
Resizing clears mobile parallax, the header remains anchored, and a live reduced-motion change restores a static page

staticGates.result: 36 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 1 existing unused-import hint

staticGates.command: node --check scripts/visual-audit.mjs; node --check scripts/browser-qa.mjs; git diff --check
Source scan for arrow/chevron/close glyphs and named arrow entities

manualReview.additionalReview: Fresh before/after hero, contacts320, services320/390, representative full templates, final mobile/desktop modal/filter/gallery states, before/after AVA media, native-scroll Close and final footer320/1024 were visually viewed. This is not a claim that every pixel in every full-page image was individually compared.

limits: No claim of pixel-perfect equality, physical iPhone or shipping Safari certification.
No sustained FPS, GPU memory, thermal or Core Web Vitals measurement.
Larger existing cover derivatives preserve source detail and may increase bytes versus the incorrect 480w selection; the prior loading report is not a measurement of this patch.
Atlantis original exterior is capped at 1024w; high-DPR/tall frames can remain source-limited.
All enquiry submissions were mocked; live storage and public deployment verification belong to the release owner.
